dominant_strengths: Massive serif 'R1S' wordmark creates a striking editorial moment that anchors the scroll with confident automotive presence
Restrained monochrome palette (charcoal, black, muted gray) lets the vehicle photography carry visual weight without competing chrome
Clean floating pill nav with adequate whitespace reads as premium and gets out of the product's way
dominant_weaknesses: Cookie consent modal blocks the entire left half of the hero, destroying the carefully composed scroll moment and crushing first impression
Pagination dots sit awkwardly mid-frame against the previous slide, reading as orphaned UI rather than an integrated scroll indicator
Yellow chat FAB and yellow 'Demo drive' CTA are the only saturated elements but don't form a coherent accent system across the page
fix_priorities: Redesign cookie consent as a slim bottom banner so the R1S typographic hero remains uninterrupted
Reposition or restyle pagination indicators to belong to the active section, not float between hero slides
Unify the yellow accent language between CTA, chat bubble, and any hover states for systemic consistency
Tighten vertical rhythm between the carousel hero and the R1S section so the scroll transition feels intentional
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral impact from the oversized serif is real, but behavioral clarity collapses under the consent modal and reflective brand prestige is diluted by inconsistent accent usage.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially delivers the Rivian scroll experience — the editorial typographic sections show ambition, but consent overlay and weak section transitions prevent the scroll from feeling cinematic.
